goals.title: Rename Session Picker to Dojo Picker
goals.description: Align picker vocabulary with the topology model: Dojos are resumable terminal layouts, while Lairs are workspace containers and Splints are panes/processes. Rename user-facing Session Picker and Recent Sessions surfaces to Dojo Picker and Recent Dojos; add canonical `splinterm dojos`; retain documented compatibility aliases; and update internal picker names where safe.

goals.title: Redesign Lair retention and saved-workspace lifecycle
goals.description: Make inactive Lairs useful and intentional rather than accumulated anonymous history. Define named, pinned, preset-derived, and disposable Lair states; automatically retire low-value exited `terminal-*` Lairs under a clear bounded policy; preserve active detached Lairs; expose save, pin, restore, and delete actions; clarify inactive Dojo restoration; and make picker presentation distinguish live, detached, restorable, and expired states without persisting shell contents or sensitive terminal data.
